functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display the first lines of at least 90% of the news articles based on their titles on the title screen for all specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to show the first lines of news articles, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load and display the first lines of news articles in less than 500 milliseconds for up to 100 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to news articles, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must clearly display the title and the first lines of each news article in a readable font size (at least 12 points) and color scheme that provides sufficient contrast.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to show news articles, which should be easily recognizable and readable for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to recover from errors and continue displaying news articles within 2 seconds of encountering an issue.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to news articles, necessitating fault tolerance to ensure system availability.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate user input data (e.g., email address, password, mobile number) according to predefined rules (e.g., password length, email format) for 100% of account creation attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and valid user data for account creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt user personal data (e.g., password, mobile number) using TLS 1.3 during transmission and store it securely using a salted hash.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive user data, which requires protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear and concise instructions for creating a Gmail account, including required field labels and error messages, to facilitate user understanding.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with the system, which should be easy to learn and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to create Gmail accounts for 99.95% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to account creation services, necessitating high availability.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support at least 80% of common image, video, and audio file formats (e.g., JPEG, PNG, MP4, MP3) for import and management within presentations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle various data formats, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 200 MB of memory to import and manage a single media file within a presentation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple media files.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for importing and managing media files within presentations, including clear buttons and menus for file selection and formatting options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with media files, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy addition of new media file formats through a modular and extensible architecture, with a maximum of 2 days required for integration and testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling various data formats, which may require future updates and modifications.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to set the price, quantity, upload pictures, and add details when listing an item.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate user input data (e.g., price, quantity) according to predefined rules (e.g., price range, quantity limits) for 100% of item listing attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and valid user data for item listing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must prevent users from uploading pictures that exceed a maximum file size limit (e.g., 5 MB) or are not in a supported format (e.g., JPEG, PNG), and provide clear error messages instead.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with the system, which should protect against user errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and save item listing details, including picture uploads, in less than 2 seconds for up to 50 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to item listing services, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that item listing data (e.g., price, quantity, pictures) is not modified or deleted without authorization, using access controls and audit logs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive item data, which requires protection against unauthorized modifications.

functionalRequirement: Doctors shall be able to log in to check patient information, answer patient queries, perform daily activities, set reminders, and communicate with their staff.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide access to at least 90% of patient information fields (e.g., medical history, test results) for doctors to view and manage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide access to patient information, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt patient information using TLS 1.3 during transmission and store it securely using a salted hash, with access controls and audit logs to ensure HIPAA compliance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing sensitive patient data, which requires protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for doctors to interact with patient information, including clear menus, buttons, and search functions, to facilitate efficient use.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires doctor interaction with the system, which should be engaging and easy to use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for doctors to access patient information and perform daily activities for 99.99% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to patient information and daily activities, necessitating high availability.
